title: The Unexpected Summer
author: Marguerite Sterling
blurb: Noor Halloran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
